verdict.rationale: Algolia's Agent Studio lets customers wire an LLM to Algolia search/tools to build assistants (shopping assistants, conversational search, content summarizers) that are 'built-in' to the product's AI stack, which partially matches the story. However, this is aimed at end-users of the customer's own app rather than an AI-native user delegating administrative/config tasks to an assistant embedded in the Algolia dashboard itself — missing for 10: evidence of a first-party assistant inside the Algolia console/CLI that lets a user delegate index/config management tasks conversationally, and any hands-on/independent proof of Agent Studio's assistant behavior in practice.
